notes.title: UPDATE 0.42
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827466/d6862c8dc9b9bda778da9cdc5080d17c4f79f6b0.png[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] New map added: Cave
[*] Game Difficulty added. (3 Modes: Survivor, Hero, Impossible)
[*] Dash system added. It can be used with the "Shift" key.
[*] Additional visual effects added when the player takes damage.
[*] Abilities on cooldown now show warning messages in the UI.
[*] Characters now have special lighting on dark maps.
[*] Some level music and sound effects have been changed.
[*] Lighting and environmental arrangements of some levels have been updated.
[*] Player camera angle has been changed.
[*] Special key "Shift" has been changed to "F".
[*] Improvements made to the save system.
[*] Optimization and performance updates.
[/list]
[b]Important Notice:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Your save files may be deleted during the update[/i]
Go to C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\KingMustSurvive (replace <username> with your own Windows username) and delete the contents of this folder.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827466/8efd6eded3dd561417e1bb36b3353f872931fbb6.png[/img]

Our new map, "The Web of Deceit," is now in our game! At the heart of the map, your greatest enemy awaits you: Spider Queen Exeial.

In addition, we have added a mystery to this map. Players must solve this mystery and defeat the boss to succeed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827466/ad0aaba3bd99223df27ad3f3d3326b9156cdb906.png[/img]

We no longer allow meshes to obstruct your character, ensuring a better gameplay experience in the maps.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.41
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827466/c1910c5a3c1c9955cec0c8ff23f3aed889ca1730.png[/img]

Updates:
[list]
[*] Magnet item added (drops randomly from barrels. collects all XP souls not yet collected)
[*] Reduced barrel regeneration time from 120 to 90.
[*] Increased the health item drop rate from barrels.
[*] Mouse left button now casts a weapon swing that deals damage.
[*] Richard's starting speed increased from 525 to 540.
[*] Reduced the base running speed of farmer enemies.
[*] Castle map is now changed to chapter 2.
[*] Fixed a bug where knights were not spawning
[*] Fixed shared save files from different accounts on the same computer. Now saves are taken based on steam profile.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from dealing damage in Tutorial map.
[*] Optimization updates
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Investigating the source of randomly occurring Fatal Error messages.
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The Second Skill has been activated. You can now use your unique skills with the Ctrl key.
[*] Usage of the Second Skill has been added to the Tutorial level.
[*] Cooldowns have been implemented for both the First and Second Skills after usage.
[*] King Richard's appearance has been redesigned. Second skill added: Creates a holy area for 2 seconds.
[*] Queen Luna's appearance has been redesigned. Second skill added: Sends forth an army of horses for 4 seconds in the field of view.
[*] Character base speeds have been increased.
[*] Characters now carry unique weapons. (cCrowns are back on their heads)
[*] Sizes of gold and chickens dropped from chests have been reduced.
[*] Base health values of enemies have been decreased.
[*] Base movement speed of enemies has been increased.
[*] Enemy spawns have been reorganized. They will now try to confront you more aggressively.
[*] Optimization updates.
[/list]
